title: Upgrade Fee for a Move to Northgate Plus
content:
**Clause.** The upgrade fee for moving a membership of Northgate Memberships to its Plus tier is the annual fee of the Plus tier the membership moves to, 130.00 dollars, less the annual fee of the tier the membership is held at, charged in full on the upgrade date, never below zero and kept to the cent.

**Terms.**

- *Annual fee of the Plus tier moved to:* 130.00 dollars, for Northgate Club Plus Membership and for Northgate Business Plus Membership alike.
- *Annual fee of the tier held:* the annual fee of the tier on the membership on the upgrade date.
- *Charged in full:* the whole amount is charged on the upgrade date as one upgrade difference charge.

## Worked figures

| Tier held on the upgrade date | Plus tier moved to | Working | Upgrade fee |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Club Membership (annual fee 65.00) | Northgate Club Plus Membership | 130.00 less 65.00 | 65.00 |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership (annual fee 45.50) | Northgate Club Plus Membership | 130.00 less 45.50 | 84.50 |
| Northgate Business Membership (annual fee 65.00) | Northgate Business Plus Membership | 130.00 less 65.00 | 65.00 |

The fee is charged in full on the upgrade date and kept to the cent as worked.
